speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe when the swelling and pain in your right ring finger started and if there was any recent injury or insect bite?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you hear or feel a "pop" at the moment of injury, and is the finger currently stuck in a bent position or can you straighten it fully? I would also like to inspect the finger for any deformity or bruising.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text: I suspect a Jersey Finger injury, which is an avulsion of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon. To confirm this, I need to see the imaging. REQUEST IMAGES.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant medical history. Social history: Student and active in sports, particularly football. Non-smoker and drinks alcohol socially.

speaker: Doctor
text: The inability to flex the distal interphalangeal joint with the finger resting in extension confirms a flexor digitorum profundus tendon rupture. DIAGNOSIS READY: Jersey Finger (Flexor Digitorum Profundus Avulsion)

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
